annotation.description:
the vides shows different scenes of stand up paddeling.
in the first scene, 2 surfers, one wearing a red swimsuit, whil the other wears a white shirt and black swimwear, are on their boards and are navigating with a padel.
the water hits the camerat and only the surfer with the red swimsuit sis visible.
next a woman wearing a cyan bikini is shown on a surfboard and paddeling.
lastly, the next scene shows the surfer with the red swimwear holding the surfboard outside of the water at the beach.
weather is sunny.
